country: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

examples.note: South Georgia shares the Falkland Islands numbering plan; King Edward Point is served through it

notes: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands have no separate country code and no permanent civilian population; the territory shares +500 with the Falkland Islands.
Communications serve the British Antarctic Survey station at King Edward Point and visiting vessels, and satellite services are widely used in place of terrestrial numbering.
sources: Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands: https://www.gov.gs/
